data.description: In iOS Safari web app mode, I'm unable to use Google auth using redirect flow because of this. I tried doing the popup flow but it doesn't seem to work since it doesn't go back to the app. What's the recommended workaround for this?

NewMarkdownViewer-module__safe-html-box__ZT1eD"><p dir="auto">I just tested and it seems that the "Redirect" auth mode works in an "Added to homescreen" app on iOS. So you can use this as a workaround for now.</p>
<p dir="auto">I did get stuck with the "Popup" auth mode though so it looks like we have a bug.</p>
<p dir="auto"><a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/bojeil-google/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/bojeil-google" aria-keyshortcuts="Alt+ArrowUp">@bojeil-google</a>: it looks like popup auth is broken for "Added to homescreen" app on iOS. Would be nice if there was a workaround to fix it because the  experience is somewhat a lot better in popup mode than in redirect mode on iOS homescreen apps: You see the URL in a custom tab whereas with the redirect mode you don't see the URL of the Google signin page and you're basically entering your password in an unknown website...</p>
<p dir="auto">In the mean time you can use this workarround to detect homescreen iOS apps and use the redirect flow only on these apps.This is an example if you are using firebaseUI:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre class="notranslate">  <span class="pl-k">var</span> <span class="pl-s1">signInFlow</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s">'popup'</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
  <span class="pl-c">// For iOS full screen apps we use the redirect auth mode.</span>
  <span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">'standalone'</span> <span class="pl-k">in</span> <span class="pl-smi">window</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">navigator</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
      <span class="pl-c1">&&</span> <span class="pl-smi">window</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">navigator</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">standalone</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">{</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">signInFlow</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s">'redirect'</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span>

  <span class="pl-c">// FirebaseUI config.</span>
  <span class="pl-k">var</span> <span class="pl-s1">uiConfig</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
    <span class="pl-s">'signInFlow'</span>: <span class="pl-s1">signInFlow</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
    <span class="pl-s">'signInOptions'</span>: <span class="pl-kos">[</span>
      <span class="pl-s1">firebase</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">auth</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">GoogleAuthProvider</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">PROVIDER_ID</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
      <span class="pl-s1">firebase</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">auth</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">FacebookAuthProvider</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">PROVIDER_ID</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">]</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
  <span class="pl-k">var</span> <span class="pl-s1">firebaseUi</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-s1">firebaseui</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">auth</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">AuthUI</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">firebase</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">auth</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container position-absolute right-0 top-0">

  // For iOS full screen apps we use the redirect auth mode.
  if (('standalone' in window.navigator)
      && window.navigator.standalone){
    signInFlow = 'redirect';
  }

  // FirebaseUI config.
  var uiConfig = {
    'signInFlow': signInFlow,
    'signInOptions': [
      firebase.auth.GoogleAuthProvider.PROVIDER_ID,
